g.text: Ceiling: how much better weather could add

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'ERA5 (and CAMS) are estimates of past weather and arrive days late, so no serving system could use them: each row is a ceiling for a weather product of that accuracy. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months and seeds. Demand: 73 forecast runs, one every 5 days. Solar and wind: 53 Tuesday runs. Validation year July 2025 to June 2026.'
text.tspan: ERA5 (and CAMS) are estimates of past weather and arrive days late, so no serving system could use
them: each row is a ceiling for a weather product of that accuracy. Dot: estimate. Line: 95%
interval from re-drawing whole months and seeds. Demand: 73 forecast runs, one every 5 days. Solar
and wind: 53 Tuesday runs. Validation year July 2025 to June 2026.
